author: Hawking, Stephen W.
review:
One last book from Stephen Hawking and it is indeed was a joy to read. Science & Technology needs to be taught to our younger generation. Answers are very simple but it requires collective research from mankind. This is not a fiction book but still made me emotional while reading its afterword by Lucy Hawking. 

Stephen Hawking explained very nicely each question that needs an answer for. His opinions are crafted into his words. Every answer he gave to the questions ultimately asks everyone to look up to stars and unleash their imagination. Nothing is impossible. We mustn't give up as humanity.
title: Brief Answers to the Big Questions

author: Mackesy, Charlie
review:
Wonderfully Crafted I would say. 
All the drawing, illustrations bring out the artists that inside us. Reading each page and experiencing art made me feel good about life and myself. 

This book is for those who are lite hearted, Introverts, Reserved, Depressed, The Happiest, Courageous, Brave and Showstoppers. Every page and quote brings inner you outside and each drawings/illustrations decorate these positive thoughts. Love as much as ypu can and you will be loved forever.
title: The Boy, the Mole, the Fox and the Horse

author: Fritz, Roger
review:
There is only one word I can say, LEADERSHIP. 
Every word and page in this book is so good that each insight you can get in order to build a company or people skill is completely sublime. 

It is a good read. It is a little book but the words are so mature to understand. Very powerful book to read if you want to build your character and change yourself. Keep in mind these 7 traits, SROSIAC (Self-Esteem, Responsibility, Optimism, Steady, Imagination, Awareness, Creativity). 

To end my review about this, I would like to write the final words of the book here, 

"Attitude is the scale on which we balance our strengths and
limitations. Outside circumstances are less important in the long run than our inner view of our selves."

Attitude is everything and also having positive attitude is a charm. Build upon your character with EQ. When you have goodness in your heart, life never lets you down. It is going to be hard but once you reach your level, you will live forever by leaving being your legacy of the greatest significance.
title: The Power of a Positive Attitude

author: Drucker, Peter F.
review:
A Little book of Management and it is like "As a man thinketh" special. 

One word for this book is, IMPROVEMENT. 

What are our values? How to manage boss? How best you can contribute to this world? Having second careers in life and finally, "Knowledge Outlive Organization."

Some useful insights and can be read within 60 mins but when the methods are applied, you will indeed manage yourself well in life and in business.
title: Managing Oneself (Harvard Business Review Classics)

author: Carnegie, Dale
review:
Single word for the book is PRACTICE. As long as we practice each and every word we speak, we will struggle to put it in our speaking marathon. 

I will discuss how it felt while reading the book rather than reviewing this book because this book is all about feeling and building yourself into a person who gives value to your words and meaning to what you have in mind. Dale Carnegie described in a wonderful way about how to keep our words fresh and the thoughts we convey. 

The straight forward solution to develop Self Confidence is diction. Hold of your language that you speak. Words that you speak came from a number of different religion, cultures and languages. Starting, Finishing and Composing speeches are very important not only at the time of public speaking but also at the time when you are having a talk with someone or in attending interviews. 

Humorously explained points and in some places, he explained the fact strictly to follow. Dedicating sometime in our life to read books instead of reading Newspapers will definitely increase our value. Sit in a place or grab 20 of the pages in a book and keep it in your pocket, read those pages and once that completes, put it there and take another 20 and so on. Learning every day and reading every day requires will power and those who do it will thrive. 

Speaking of speeches, construct them by looking at the audience. Appeal to their interests. While reading the book it feels like you have got a lot of things to change in life to be confident. I enjoyed reading the book. It took me longer than usual to complete but worth the time reading it. 

These brilliant insights quotes in this book are working very well for me. Dale Carnegie became direct in convincing readers than in HOW TO WIN FRIENDS AND INFLUENCE PEOPLE. I have read this book after reading THINK AND GROW RICH. Napoleon Hill and Dale Carnegie feel like an identical person. 

Their style of expressing in their books are almost similar. I love both of them.
title: How to Develop Self-Confidence & Influence People by Public Speaking

author: Kleon, Austin
review:
Great book and inspirational. Showing what you do and be creative at that part. Create a website, get subscribers, never let any trolls to breach your mental firewall. Show your work coz, others have many things to show you as well. With the collaboration, you can grow and help others grow. 

Insightful points to keep ourselves to start something better. I recommend for those who wants to begin again.
title: Show Your Work!: 10 Ways to Share Your Creativity and Get Discovered

author: Isaacson, Walter
review:
One Word, LEGENDARY GENIUS

I can't explain how great Steve Jobs. If I start how much he inspired me in my pursuit, I will go on to write about him the whole day. He is not as an ideal thinker as someone like Bill Gates. The step Steve has taken inspires tough minds who want to make a mark or dent in the universe of their own. Despite less knowledge in technology, he had complete control over what he was doing and what to give for humanity. His thinking to control every aspect of user experience and building great products for a great company had brought a revolution in the industry. He is a philanthropist for humanity and a messenger of perfectionism. 

Still, a lot to talk about him, and the way Walter Issacson portrayed his nature in this book is stunning. Enjoyed each chapter in this book. As I kept reading, it never occurred to me that the book is completed.
title: Steve Jobs

author: Sadhguru
review:
I have to give 5 stars to this. This is not a one-time read kind of book. It is more sophisticated technology than any other. Windings of Karma are completely based on life force. One simple thing we can take away from this book is, live this life fully without dwelling on the past and predicting the future. Life is the greatest gift and magic altogether and we don't need for any miracles to happen as we already in the miracle. 

Unwinding Karma can be done in 3 ways, Physical, Mental and Spiritual. 

As long as we work hard without expecting something as a reward, consider that we are burning Karma. If you are conscious enough and say you need to burn it, then it is deep Karma. Attaining spirituality is the whole process of life where everything is connected. 

Wonderfully crafted book by Sadhguru to make us understand what exactly we are missing in life and how we all can come forward to help each other which in turn serves the whole purpose of creation. End of the movie.
title: Karma: A Yogi's Guide to Crafting Your Destiny

author: Sharma, Robin S.
review:
It is a little book that caught my eye while browsing through Amazon Books. I started reading it topically by topic, thoughts by thoughts. It is one of the tiny but yet extensive jewels to have in your library where you can come and glace it through when your day is bad or you want suggestion how to live your life in serene. 

The 101 guides for having a better life and becoming a person you want to be. The growth you can have after adopting these tips in your life is instrumental. 

I can say, a well-deserved book to read and be thankful for the life - You can see why Robin Sharma is called Global Humanitarian.
title: Who Will Cry When You Die?

author: Sadhguru
review:
Very hard to digest the realities of life. Often sometimes there are things that make us to question about. This is a comprehensive guide on how to live our lives. Started this book with a mind that seeking answers for so many questions in life. Today I am ending this book with the right questions to ask myself with. 

This is very much intensified book for those who need answers for creation and energy around us. Sadhguru started with explaining details about death and stages of it, extending reach on how to respect the dead and finally helping us to understand what disembodied state means. Now the final frontier is, "It is okay to die in this lifetime but before you do make sure you live it. Ultimately, exit the physical form with consciousness."
title: Death: An Inside Story

author: Coelho, Paulo
review:
My second fiction book other than Harry Potter. It is simply incredible and loved it. One brilliant concept that I uncovered is that true love never pull you from reaching your destiny. Challenges that comes in life is totally welcoming if you are sure to reach your destiny. It is a portrayal of, "Fall in love with the journey of life rather than the end goal."

"A boy who set his sails to find a treasure, found himself the soul of the world which is 100 times precious than a treasure."
title: The Alchemist

author: Krishnamurti, Jiddu
review:
I can say this book is a part of #OriginalCollection. J. Krishnamurthi spoke about freedom and release ourselves from understanding the depth of love. You can only be changed from yourself, not by the influence of others. When you change yourself from observer to observed, there will be no commitments in life. No fear, no bounds, no Violence, no brutality. Just a simple self who understand oneself and projects the real connection. 

When we see things as what it should be, you will be not free from your thoughts that later become a memory which turns to pleasure. When there is pleasure in life, there is pain. To be free and attain freedom, always see what is than what it should be. 

This book is of a different level where it is difficult to understand for simple readers. This requires in-depth knowledge of oneself and understanding about inward actions in us. This is not a book, this is life mentor and takes our thinking to the next level of our understanding. Advanced topics explained in a very strong manner. It starts with strict rules of humanity and as it progresses keeps getting better. In the end, it is all about love and meditation of life.

One word for this book is "Mind."
title: Freedom from the Known

author: Hawking, Stephen W.
review:
The single phrase to explain this book is, "UNIVERSE UNCOVERED."

A Brief History of Time is a masterpiece in understanding physics and to know who we are. It expands our view and broaden our sight to see higher thing in life and understand what beautiful minds are working on. Literally a breath taking ingenious celestial masterpiece. 

YOU GOTTA READ IT TO EXPERIENCE THE FUN THAT IS IN OUR UNIVERSE. I recommend this book to all enthusiastic reader who wants to know the answers about our existence. If you looking for some inspiration to think about the existence of life, read this and let me know your thoughts. Dimensions, Space-Time, Laws, Theories, Black Holes, Big Bang. 

Happy Reading, #KeepSmiling
title: A Brief History of Time

author: Hill, Napoleon
review:
One word for this book is, BELIEVE. This didn't come to me till reading last page of the book. 

From the Page 1 Napoleon Hill suggest us that the secret to grow rich and accumulate riches is there in the book amd explained in 13 different points and scenerios. Including last 14th one I can call the list of fears. Perfectly categorised and explained about how to be awesome in life. When I started this book, I was indebted hugely for my bank. At the completion of this book after following the steps written in this book and adopting the lessons of THE POWER OF YOUR SUBCONSCIOUS MIND, My finite intelligence is able to communicate with Infinite Intelligent. 

To THINK AND GROW RICH, all we need to do is to BELIEVE IN YOURSELF. Believe in Humanity, Believe in Infinite Intelligence and Believe in Faith.
title: Think and Grow Rich

author: Newport, Cal
review:
Single Word: PRODUCTIVE

In our modern world, we always have a kind of distraction all the time. Sometimes these distractions being from the most powerful machines. Instead of fighting with them, we are fighting for them to defend them. This is the money world right now, we think world thrive only with large economies. Building trillion dollar company is far important than building a happy life and helping other to contribute to the collective genius of the world. Digital Minimalism is one concept that help you to find your inner self with the help of technology, not destroyed by it. 

Cal explains methods to build such life where we use limited amount of time wasting and improving ourselves by doing productive work in unproductive times. Solitude being one of the key aspect or the seed for great ideas that come into action. 

Enjoyed reading every page of it. Cal injested some nice views of his own and strict rules to follow in order to become humans again.
title: Digital Minimalism: Choosing a Focused Life in a Noisy World

author: Attri, Vee Jay
review:
From stepping next step in our life till the last breath, our doings are the reason for the life we have. It is an exceptional book to read and easy to understand the words written by author. 60 keys to life and if we follow 10% of it, our life will get better each day. 

We reap what we sow likewise, we build our virtues by doing good deeds. This is explained in Chapter 5 very well. 

Everytime you read the book, it seems new and we understand the gist differently in a good way depending on the mindset you are in.
title: The Secret of Karma

author: Allen, James
review:
I mist give 5 stars to this book. Definitely, this book needs to be read more than once. This little book is the powerhouse and every line is the weapon to live life fully. 

Serene life makes everyone to love us. Calmness in heart and goodness in our thoughts always make us the most loved person. To reach that level you have to take a step back in life and start living in it. Read this book and I can say it is one of the must-reads.
title: As a Man Thinketh

author: Vaynerchuk, Gary
review:
It brought a smile to my face. It is really a book for those who are wishing to build a business online. Even if you don't want to start a business, you can get an insight into how the online world works and helps startups to build business individually. 

We create our own brands now. We are not accustomed to ole traditional corporate politics to post a front-page ad in newspapers. We can do it on our own. If you have an idea, just be the best one to execute it. Build a community of your own where people understands you and the biggest marketing strategy is CARE. 

I enjoyed reading every part of this book that has 13 of them. 

I don't like to waste your time in reading this review, just go and read the book straight away. If you have the huger to build, then reading this book is one of the perfect ways to start with.
title: Crush It!: Why Now Is the Time to Cash In on Your Passion

author: Covey, Stephen R.
review:
It is a masterpiece to preserve for and also the true human habits we all should follow to win inside and to live outside in this world. The 7 Habits that mentioned in this book are hard to follow but upon following them consistently or trying to adapt them in our life bring out huge changes to our well-being. I loved the way Dr. Covvey has installed one habit after the other. 1, 2 & 3 are for improving our integrity and 4, 5, & 6 are for learning interdependence. 7th Habit is the one that governs all 6 habits. 

We all live in a value-driven society with self-defined principles. Values come from the environment we grow in and principles are decisive. We need to build our own principles to support synergy and learning to understand others before expecting them to understand us helps us to derive Win/Win situations in life. 

One of the best books I've ever read. Truly the Masterpiece.
title: The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People: Powerful Lessons in Personal Change

author: Chopra, Deepak
review:
Well... Well... One word for this book is SELF-REALISATION. 

This book is a simple guide for you to understand about you and life. We all need to understand here that Success is life. There is no failure in it unless we stamp a moment or mindset as a failure. Everything happens in our life is just a projection of our own thought. LUCK is the result of PERSISTANCE. 

It took me 58.22 minutes to complete this sweet little book. To tell about this book, I'd rather say read it yo know it. Instead of reading reviews about this book, just buy an eBook or the hardcopy and just read it. 

Serene and peaceful read. I suggest you to open your mind and read this book. Keep aside all your benchmark wishes and just observe the beauty of life and understand the laws of nature where it stands tall. Everything in this universe is connected to frequencies. Attaining the perfect frequency for effortless life is the key for all of us to enjoy life with less attachment to things and dwell on negatives. 

#Spiritual #LifeLessons
title: The Seven Spiritual Laws of Success: A Pocketbook Guide to Fulfilling Your Dreams

author: Hawking, Stephen W.
review:
One word I can say is BRILLIANCE PERSONIFIED. 

Talks by the person who understands world in a right way and look at it in his own fantasy. Stephan Hawking is one of the brightest and inspirational personalities. His humour makes you laugh while reading this book and his directness in appealing his theories are lovely. 

Never get bored of reading his works. This book gives an insight about his works and also his life. It gives a picture about him and his level of thinking. At last everything works in mysterious ways even particles as well. 

Main take away from this book is about HAWKING RADIATION. To know, dive in and don't wait to read this book.
title: Black Holes and Baby Universes and Other Essays

author: Keller, Jeff
review:
One word for this book is, 
CONFIDENCE. 

Review: 
It is indeed a book that inspire you to up your game and urges reader to be positive and think positive with confidence. Weakness is not the spot where word looks. Be positive and have the attractive attitude. It its 3 parts, Jeff explained so clearly that to build good life, you must have the attitude that respects people and more than anything that should bring respect to you and the way you lead your life.
title: Attitude Is Everything: Change Your Attitude ... Change Your Life!

author: King, Patrick
review:
One Word, "PAUSE TO THINK"

Words are pretty clear when Patrick explains about how to think clearly. Primarily, speed thinking is a way to escape clear thinking or to neglect the actual facts that we uncover in our journey. Mindful thinking might be slow but it leads to get the facts right. Being Intellectually honest , Open minded helps you to get to the bottom of something more clearly. Stopping to trust our instincts & questioning the facts ofter help us to know better about something. 

Remember, clear thinking is not about finding solution, it is about understanding the facts and go deep into finding the truth. 

We written practices. If we persist with clear thinking, we can be the next Einstein, Elon Musk, Descartes or Socrates.
title: The Art of Clear Thinking

author: Tiffany, John
review:
One Word, LOVE OF FATHER AND THE SON. 

Every scene in this make sense and the final book of this series is all about making sure that Harry Potter legacy is safe. There is Fun in the book along with there are few scenes where your eyes will be filled with tears. We can enjoy reading this. 

Since this is my fist fiction book, I got intense in my imagination. Felt like everything is happening infront of me. Imagined each and every character and places depending on how I watched movies. 

Draco and Harry will become good friends at the end. Love of Ron and Hermione feels so great and their discussions are too fun. Read the book to know more.
title: Harry Potter and the Cursed Child: Parts One and Two

author: Sharma, Robin S.
review:
**spoiler alert** One Word for this book is, SELF-LEADING,

This book has got its own flavor. I can see enjoyed reading this. Started with 1 idea each day for 36 days and later I had to read rest 34 in 2 days. Total 70 useful ways of life is mentioned to improve our daily life. Each one of them can make a difference to our whole life. 

I cannot say that we all need to follow all 70, pick any 5 first and adapt those changes to your life first and then you can see how this encourages you to be better.
title: Little Black Book for Stunning Success+ Tools for Action Mastery

author: Swami, Om
review:
Good Book to Read about Business

Principles mentioned in this book are simple but yet powerful in their own way. SACRED principle and EPIC rules standout. Enjoyed reading and in middle, Om Swami - The Author, explains basic principles that we can follow and cultivate in order to be successful in this world. Total of 180 pages is likes 180 guides to be what we are and find the true purpose of what we are up to in life. 

Once we find clarity about what we need to do, everything will be easy and it will followby discipline. If I can say about this book in a single word, I'd say, "Mindset!!!"

author: Murphy, Joseph
title: The Power of Your Subconscious Mind

author: Gates, Bill
title: How to Avoid a Climate Disaster: The Solutions We Have and the Breakthroughs We Need

This little book is the quick suggestion to lead life, talk to our mind and condition it for serving better purposes. Good read.
title: The Miracles of Your Mind: Are you ready to unlock your true potential?

author: Tracy, Brian
review:
One word, PRODUCTIVE. 

All of these 21 steps are like 21 gold mines to dig. If we don't stop procrastination and start doing things, someone might make us do what they want. Each insights about work in this book is priceless and indeed worked for me when I sat with myself for sometime gave it a thought. 

Christmas Completion! I suggest to read one insight per day and apply one by one in your daily life and start practicing them again and again.
title: Eat That Frog! 21 Great Ways to Stop Procrastinating and Get More Done in Less Time

author: Harvard Business Review
review: Simple but yet powerful insights and suggestions on building creative teams. I was facing the crisis on leading teams and assigning rosters but this book made me confident and helped me to take right decission. It is like a little companion to encourage you in building a great team.
title: Innovative Teams (HBR 20-Minute Manager Series)

author: Hawking, Stephen W.
review: Collection of well defined lectures. There are concepts that are repeated from the masterpiece A brief history of time. Since it is the collection of his talks, it was a good read to remember one of the greatest minds in physics.
title: The Theory of Everything: The Origin and Fate of the Universe

author: Hughes, Howard
review:
The last sentence of the book is about hope and added with some humor, "So, if you feel you are in a black hole, don't give up: there is a way out!" This was the most hopeful thing I have ever heard from anyone. 

One sentence for the book is, "ESCAPE PLAN FROM BLACK HOLES." 

Very well described the concept of Black Holes and how we can further analyse the way out from there. Is there a connection to another Universe, Dimensions or is it really lost when anything go inside a Black Hole. 

I suggest you to read A BRIEF HISTORY OF TIME before reading this books. Have some idea about Universe before diving in. Afterall Universe is all ours.
title: Black Holes The Reith Lectures

author: Vance, Ashlee
review: No need to write much of a review. It is like if you want to know about Elon officially here is a material for you.

review:
54 better articles to improve our life. Good read this week. It is better to read this after reading the book "Attitude is Everything."

Very well organised topics with clean message to improve attitude and this helps to build a better life and communication.

author: Newport, Cal
review: Powerful words by the powerful author. It has got detailed ways to convince us that why working Deep is important in one's life.
title: Deep Work: Rules for Focused Success in a Distracted World

author: Poet, Humble the
review:
Wonderful read for motivation. It is not a continuous chapter based book. There are 101 simple yet powerful reflections you can have in your life. Most of them says about being mindful about your life and what you are doing. 

Each reflection is like a question you can ask yourself and help yourself to bring back your life on the right track toward your destination. This book can be your motivator when you feel low. It is refreshing to the mind. 

Unless you implement atleast one of them in this book, it is difficult to understand what Kanwer (Author) has to say.
title: Unlearn: 101 Simple Truths for a Better Life

author: Krogerus, Mikael
review:
Collection of suggestions and information about communication is simply fantastic. Illustrated art makes us to remember each ideas better. It is good to randomly select one out of 44 ideas and reading it on the go. 

Upon following the rules and suggestion specified in this book bought lot of positive changes in life.
title: The Communication Book: 44 Ideas for Better Conversations Every Day

author: Vivekananda
review:
One word for the book is, "Be Responsible."

You are the creator of your own fate and destiny. Collection of Powerful thoughts about the great man. My Lifelong Mentor. 

When you read something that is written by the person who you listened to his work every night as a lullaby, feeling is phenomenal. 

This book needs to be read in the form of motivation. I say, read this book and accumilate the thoughts in it in your everyday life. You will definitely, go beyond your fear.
title: Thoughts of power

author: Peale, Norman Vincent
review:
This is definitely not a religious book as others are saying. This book makes you believe that there is a higher energy where it is beyond our understanding which is reponsible for performing miracles in one's life. To put it in layman terms, if you believe you can do it, then you will do it. This simple understanding of life can make miracles happen. 

Pray for it in the sense ask for what you need and it will be done unto you. This is the gist of all religions. Since Norman was a christian, he tried to explain in its own way. Good one to read when you need answers and belief to go on with life.
title: The Power of Positive Thinking

author: Carnegie, Dale
review:
The book that helped me to transform my communication skills. The insights that are provided in this book, still works now relentlessly. It took me a while to complete the book and understamd the concepts that are instilled in it. But every steps I adopted to my life worked like a charm. 

Before reading this book, I had 0 friends and now after completion, I have more than 10 friends who have my back. I discovered good in people and always tried to get the best out from them. What happened? Guess what? It worked for me. My friends understand me and gifted me books and helped me to read. 

I recommend this to those who wants to learn communication and change their life. This book is a manual develop pure humanity in life.
title: How to Win Friends & Influence People

author: Tathagatananda, Swami
review:
One Word, THE STRENGTH

Pure strength is shown in this small book that gives you hard time in understanding higher spiritual knowledge. It is well written thoughts of Swami Vivekananda and his approach to make this world clean. 

I wonder the real answer from the real person what it would be when asked that if he ever get a chance to change the world, how he would do it. His answers to the most difficult questions are simple, "Find it yourself. Every answer, religeon, and mystery is known to you already. You just need to find them within you instead of finding anywhere else."
title: Fear Not Be Strong - Vivekanada's message of strength and fearlessness

author: Kleon, Austin
review:
Pretty amazing for a book to read. I listened to the audiobook with my eyes closed. It is awesome to see how well we can construct life. The best thing I got from this book is nothing of original, everything has ever invented is nothing new to start with. They are the combinations of the works of many out there. 

Geography is not a concern anymore but still we should consider the place we live in, travelling somewhere and eat good foods. Being boring is good. Instead of quick death, a slow burnout makes you creative. 

Enjoyed the book very much. I recommend you should read it too.
title: Steal Like an Artist: 10 Things Nobody Told You About Being Creative

author: Kleon, Austin
review:
Keep going, keep smiling, keep learning, keep smiling and so on... Plant the seed that is good. It doesn't matter what mark you leave on this planet, it matters how you leave things from the day you first saw them. 

Very good book to read and also audiobook is good as well. Enjoyed the time spent. It was very inspiring.
title: Keep Going: 10 Ways to Stay Creative in Good Times and Bad (Austin Kleon)

author: Sadhguru
review:
An article length with very important message to manage ourselves. There is also a brief details about Isha Foundation and its establishments around the world. 

Manage yourself first than managing minds that are around you. One who live life happily is no different than the person with yogic enlightenment.
title: Inner Management: In the Presence of the Master

author: Harvard Business Publishing
review:
Short and very informative book. Starting from the reason to delegate work - to improve productivity and efficiency - to reviewing the completed work that is delegated. This whole process includes preparing, making amd monitoring the work of delegation. 

Interesting pointers that help increase team's ability to tackle work that requires to be completed in given time with precision. Finally my words are it is not about you working your ass off to contribute to the success of your organisation or team. You should make others work and contribute to the over all growth then only you can set yourself as an example to your peers and direct reports.
title: Delegating Work (HBR 20-Minute Manager Series)

author: Tracy, Brian
title: Kiss That Frog!: 12 Great Ways to Turn Negatives into Positives in Your Life and Work

author: Anthony, Robert
review:
The book that gives you a complete insight about how to develop yourself and to think what's right instead of living with your own paradigms. 

Thinking right is better than thinking about something else. Every chapter in your life has you to take action. It is not the hope or the universe that comes to your rescue, living in NOW is. Take action and universe will answer to all your problems. There is a higher self to support you. 

A packed guide for emotions and to move on with life. This book is a clear insight into how we need to lead our lives to be strong and independent. This book is certainly more than one time readable. Every time you read, you get a new insight to follow your life on. The path toward your goal will become clearer and the purpose of life will be redefined.
title: Beyond Positive Thinking

author: Masuno, Shunmyō
review:
Single word for this book, TRANQUIL.

It is a beautiful written book. 100 ways to improve your life. There are some that are repeated and represented in a different ways. Most probable suggestions/ways that comes in the category of Self Observing and taking care of your responsibility. 

I took me long to complete this book, I would suggest everyone to atleast adapt 10 ways that is mentioned out of 100 like, 
Gardening, Farming, Taking Deep Breaths, Making Most of Your Life, Think Nothing for 15 Minutes Everyday, Help the Needy, Living in Present, Waking Up Early and Taking Timeout for Yourself. 

I am sure, this book is not at all one time read, it is a guide to live a better and worryfree life.
title: Zen: The Art of Simple Living

author: Sharma, Robin S.
title: Daily Inspiration from The Monk Who Sold His Ferrari
